scope: Twenty paired diagnostic intents for seven Pacific and African-interior cultural identities. Cohort-focused named and thematic probes are not a blind benchmark, a complete inventory, confirmed relevance judgments or archaeological date assertions. Null adopted representatives do not mean the real locations are unknown.
